The '''Twenty-first Starfighter Division''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Division/Legends|division]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Defain]] was a member of the division who was decorated for the [[Sacking of Coruscant|Battles of Coruscant]] and [[Battle of Ilum|Ilum]], where he flew sorties. Whilst the Starfighter Division's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was chased by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Defain was assigned to the Sith Empire's [[Space station/Legends|space station]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
